_note: The Wall. 'tally' are the big numbers up top. 'awards' render newest first; 'kind' can be doctorate (highlighted) and 'future' true draws a dashed placeholder for an announced-but-not-yet-public honour. Sources: York University YFile (June 2024), Canada's Walk of Fame via Billboard Canada (Dec 2023), CBC and Billboard Canada for the Legacy Awards (Sept 2024), Ron Fanfair for the UWI gala (April 2025), The Canadian Encyclopedia for the Juno, MMVA and SOCAN counts.
intro: Nobody hands these out for a hot year. They come from showing up for three decades, for the music and for the city. The wall keeps getting longer.

awards.title: The next one
awards.body: Another honour is confirmed for 2027. Details when they are public.

awards.title: UWI Luminary Award
awards.from: The University of the West Indies, 15th Toronto Benefit Gala
awards.body: For his place as a cultural and musical ambassador.

awards.title: Icon Award
awards.from: The Black Academy, The Legacy Awards on CBC
awards.body: Presented by Jully Black for a career that carried Canadian hip-hop to the world.

awards.title: Honorary doctorate
awards.from: York University, Faculty of Liberal Arts & Professional Studies / School of the Arts, Media, Performance & Design
awards.body: Conferred June 20, 2024, for contributions to media, music and social activism. Doctor of words.

awards.title: Allan Slaight Music Impact Honour
awards.from: Canada's Walk of Fame, 25th anniversary celebration
awards.body: For using his voice and his platform to move the music industry forward. December 2, 2023.

awards.title: Ambassador, Canada 150
awards.body: Official ambassador for the country's 150th anniversary.

awards.title: Juno Award, R&B/Soul Recording of the Year
awards.body: For his part in JRDN's "Can't Choose".

awards.title: Olympic torchbearer
awards.body: Carried the flame on its way across the country.

awards.title: Juno Award, Single of the Year
awards.body: "Dangerous", featuring Akon. The first Canadian rap single in the Hot 100's top five.

awards.title: Juno Award, Rap Recording of the Year
Juno Award, Best Rap Recording
awards.body: "Northern Touch", with Rascalz, Checkmate, Thrust and Choclair. The record that put Toronto rap on the national stage.

fine: Listed from the public record. Kardi's team is adding the rest.
